correctness.rationale: Substitute Jx=0,Jy=-a,Jz=a and equal one-axis DM strengths a>0 into Li–Cao Wootters weights. Dx has duplicated eigenweights exp(2x),exp(-2x),exp(-2x),exp(2x), x=a/T, and zero concurrence for all T>0. Dy has weights 1,exp(2x),exp((sqrt5-1)x),exp(-(sqrt5+1)x); its concurrence is max(0,N(x))/sum(weights). After positive scaling, N has sign of H(x)=exp((3-sqrt5)x)-exp((1-sqrt5)x)-1-exp(-2sqrt5 x), with H(0)=-2, H(+infty)>0, H'(x)>0 for x>0. Hence unique x*=0.58258195... and Cy>0 iff 0<T<a/x*. Independently diagonalized spin-1/2 Hamiltonians and computed Wootters concurrence at T=a: Cx=0,Cy≈0.244952; checked root and open-neighborhood continuity. The source claim is the pairwise Jx>Jy heuristic, not the restrictive maximum-of-all-three claim.
